title: Smaller than 16 oz
text: Smaller than 16 oz. The cups I received were not the 16 ounce size cups.  I am able to buy the smaller ones in this style for less elsewhere.  What I am not able to find are the old style like Starbucks sold early on, that are the 16 oz size.  These are much smaller.  The 16 oz size is what I need for the "proper" Kuerig brew along with creamer, for me.  The search continues.
